issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'No Amon' (נֹא אָמוֹן), the Egyptian city Thebes/No-Amon. The Vietnamese renders it as 'Nô-âm-vôn' which appears to be a conflation or corruption of the name, adding an extra element 'vôn' not present in the Hebrew. The correct transliteration should be something like 'Nô Amôn'.
